summary: Estée Lauder filed an 8-K/A reporting that discussions with Puig regarding a potential business combination have been terminated. No definitive agreement was reached, and no specific terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The announcement follows initial confirmation of talks on March 23, 2026. Estée Lauder reaffirms its standalone strategy, "Beauty Reimagined." No board recommendation or advisors were named. The event is a termination of preliminary merger talks without formal deal terms. Watch for any subsequent strategic moves or activist pressure given the aborted transaction.
